Name: Animal Hats
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]Animal Hats[/b]
Give your farm animals adorable cosmetic hats! 
This mod adds a variety of cute hat designs for vanilla chickens using [b]Alternative Textures[/b].
Each chicken can wear a different accessory, and you can freely switch designs using the AT Scissors.

This mod replaces the full animal sprites (as required by AT), but visually functions as an “accessory mod,” adding hats on top of the vanilla animals.

[b][u] Included Hat Variations[/u][/b]
A total of [b]18 hats per chicken type[/b]:

🎩 [i]Top Hats:[/i] Black, White, Grey
🎧 [i]Earmuffs:[/i] Blue, Pink, Green
👒 [i]Straw Hats:[/i] Original, Dark, Faded
🌸 [i]Flower Hats:[/i] Purple, Navy, Bordeaux
🎀 [i]Ribbons:[/i] Red, Orange, Green, Blue, Purple, Fuchsia

Supports all vanilla chicken types:
• White Chicken
• Brown Chicken
• Blue Chicken
• Void Chicken
• Golden Chicken

More animals will be added in future updates!

[b][u]🛠 How to Use[/u][/b]
• Buy the [b]Scissors[/b] from Robin (Alternative Textures tool).
• Right-click any chicken to open the texture menu.
• Choose the hat you want—each chicken can have a different one!

Works in both [b]singleplayer and multiplayer[/b].

[b][u] Installation[/u][/b]

Install SMAPI
Install [b]Alternative Textures[/b] (required)
Unzip this mod into the Mods folder
Launch Stardew Valley

[b][u] Compatibility[/u][/b]
• Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
• Compatible with any retexture mod that does not overwrite the same chicken sprites
• Works with multiplayer (each player can choose hats independently)
